def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    insert = 0
    
    if len(str_input) > 0:
        count = 1
        for i in range(1, len(str_input)):
            if str_input[i] == str_input[i-1]:
                count += 1
            else:
                if count % 2 == 0:
                    insert += 1
                count = 1
        if count % 2 == 0:
            insert += 1
    
    print(insert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
